description: The workspace's automations, in the order they run: each is a mention filter (the search_mentions vocabulary) plus actions (labels to add, a member to assign), applied to every NEW mention the filter selects as soon as it is scored and before it is delivered.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.
